documented_facts: A managed PostgreSQL privileged account has full permissions on all databases and can manage standard accounts and databases.
A managed PostgreSQL privileged account can create accounts and execute object GRANT and REVOKE operations for standard accounts.
Alibaba Cloud directs operators to use a privileged account for schema owner operations to avoid permission errors.
Cloud Assistant SendFile supports bounded Base64 file delivery with an explicit owner, group, mode and overwrite policy.
